proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4147.3 gāvī gives regional gāi/gāy cow, including neighboring feminine forms. Survey gaiya/gəiya is compared as an expanded feminine cow form, retaining its -ya material rather than selecting the masculine gāva heading; the exact regional extension remains qualified. Exact survey form gəiya is preserved.
